notes: Verifier 2026-11-15: read the homepage, about, our farm, holiday meats and order fulfillment policy pages. The cattle are described as 100% grass-fed and grass-finished with no grain; lambs and goats are grass-fed on rotated organic pasture; pigs, boar and turkeys get certified-organic non-GMO feed with rotational grazing, so only the beef is grass-finished. Sells online, at six Chicago-area farmers markets, through pickup and home-delivery meat CSAs, by Wednesday direct delivery in Chicago, Oak Park and Evanston, and by farm pickup at Stelle. The our farm page says it can ship anywhere within the United States (UPS or FedEx outside delivery zones). No phone number found.
